Independent exact GF(2) bitset matrix powers for 18 graph cases yielded 99 correct rank identities; all 8,396 binary states in small graph instances were individually evolved until recurrence and matched exact delay and periodic counts. Finite checks do not establish all-q,m Jordan multiplicities, which follow from symbolic rank arguments.
correctness.rationale: Admissible Kautz words are length-m walks with adjacent letters unequal. For t<m, each row of F^t sums coordinates in a disjoint nonempty cylinder determined by a suffix of length m−t, giving rank q(q−1)^{m−1−t} over F2. The last-letter subspace W has dimension q and F|W=I+J; J²=qJ yields an involution for even q and idempotent projection onto even-parity vectors for odd q. Stabilized rank yields the exact periodic subspace; inverse images give all cumulative depth populations; differences of consecutive ranks give zero-Jordan block lengths, while the rank-one J specifies the eigenvalue-one blocks. Boundaries m=1 and q=2 are covered separately, and the claimed fixed/two-cycle counts follow.
risks: Only outgoing-neighbour XOR over F2. Characteristic polynomial alone does not determine zero-Jordan structure.
